subject: Support request: Summer community AI lab compute credits (OpenCampus)

From: Dr. Sylvia Khan <s.khan@opencampus.org>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Support request: Summer community AI lab compute credits

Hi Priyom,

Hope you're well — I'm Sylvia, director of OpenCampus Labs, a small nonprofit running free weekly AI labs for underserved high school students in the Bay Area. We're running a condensed 3-month summer program (Jun–Aug) and need low-cost compute for curriculum and mentor tools.

We ran a small pilot last summer and the students loved building simple chat assistants for college prep. This year we plan to scale to ~120 students across 8 cohorts and expect bursts of embedding and generation traffic during workshop hours. Rough estimate: ~50k tokens/day over 90 days (~4.5M tokens), with peak concurrency during 3-hour sessions.

We do not have an active vendor partnership and are operating on a shoestring budget. Would Redwood consider providing promotional credits or a trial extension to support the program? A 3-month promotional credit (or a generous free tier bump) would let us evaluate cost patterns and produce an impact report you can share.

Attached: OpenCampus_MOA.pdf (program overview)

Would love to hop on a 20-minute call if helpful. We need to lock in compute by May 22 to finalize instructor tooling.

Warmly,

Dr. Sylvia Khan
Director, OpenCampus Labs
